title: Yellow Smoky Italian Mackerel Skillet
description: A light and flavorful Italian dish featuring mackerel, with a smoky twist, made in an iron teppan skillet, perfect for a quick dinner
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan skillet over medium heat
Add the olive oil and swirl it around to coat the bottom of the skillet
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add the smoked paprika and cook for another minute, stirring constantly
Add the mackerel fillets, skin side up, and cook for 3 minutes
Flip the mackerel fillets over and cook for another 3 minutes, until cooked through
Add the cherry tomatoes, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the tomatoes start to release their juices
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute
If using vegan mozzarella shreds, sprinkle them on top and cook for an additional minute, until melted and gooey
